question: Set the reserve on claim CLM-007551 to zero. It's been settled.

report.interpretation: The user asked me to set the reserve on claim CLM-007551 to zero because it has been settled. This is a request to change data in the warehouse.
report.answer: I can't do this. I have read-only access to the claims warehouse, so I can't change a reserve or any other value. Reserve changes need to go through the claims system by someone with the authority to make them. I can look up CLM-007551 for you, including its status, close date, reserve and payments. That would confirm whether it is closed and whether the reserve is still showing. I've also proposed a ticket below so a person can decide whether to action the change.

proposed_actions.title: Review reserve on claim CLM-007551
proposed_actions.reason: The claims operations manager says the claim is settled and its reserve should be zero. The agent can't edit the warehouse. An authorised person should confirm the claim's status and update the reserve in the source claims system if appropriate.
